t.E470a.agn: In 2018 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported uses and use levels.
t.E470a.body: In the body it breaks down into fatty acids and the corresponding mineral; the fatty acids are used like the fats in foods.
t.E470a.eval: The fatty acid source may be vegetable or animal (including beef/pork); the source is often not stated on the label.
t.E470a.prod: It is obtained by breaking down vegetable or animal fats through a chemical process.
t.E470a.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern.
t.E470a.summary: Sodium, potassium and calcium salts of fatty acids. Used as an emulsifier and anti-caking agent; the fat source may be vegetable or animal.
t.E470a.what: It is used as an emulsifier, anti-caking agent and release agent.
